title: Automated Legal Deposition Archiving
business: Legal firms managing high volumes of recorded depositions.
problem: Manual transcription of legal proceedings is slow, prone to human error, and fails to capture specialized legal terminology accurately, leading to delays in case preparation.
solution: The GPT-Transcribe model provides high-accuracy speech-to-text capabilities by utilizing domain-specific keyword hints to ensure legal terminology is correctly captured during the transcription of audio files.
steps: Initialize a transcription request using the gpt-transcribe model ID.
Upload the recorded deposition audio file to the transcription endpoint.
Supply a list of legal keyword hints to the model to improve domain-specific accuracy.
Retrieve the structured text output for integration into the firm's case management system.
outcome: Legal teams receive near-instant, highly accurate transcripts that reduce the time spent on manual review and correction, allowing for faster case analysis.
limitation: The model may struggle with heavy background noise or overlapping speakers, which can be verified by checking the confidence scores or reviewing the raw text output for fragmented sentences.
